plan_title: 🌍 LANDS MATTER / LOAM — The signature plan (337 decks)
plan_html:
🌍 LANDS MATTER / LOAM CHOSEN PLAN

The dominant plan for Slogurk (337 Lands Matter decks + 31 Landfall on EDHREC).

  • How it plays: you play lands from your graveyard in a loop — Life from the Loam (dredge 3) brings back 3 lands per turn, Ramunap Excavator replays them, and every land that dies makes Slogurk grow (+1/+1). You sacrifice the lands (Zuran Orb, fetchlands) to trigger Slogurk again and again.
  • Core mechanic: the Loam engine — Life from the Loam plus cycling lands (Tranquil Thicket, Lonely Sandbar) equals draw + graveyard filling + land replay. Splendid Reclamation brings back your ENTIRE land graveyard at once.
  • Win conditions: an enormous Slogurk (+1/+1 per dead land) plus Titania, Protector of Argoth turning your sacrificed lands into 5/3 tokens. A board of 5/3s and a giant Slogurk equals lethal.
source_html: "Building Six: An Inside-Out Mono-Green Artifacts Deck" (EDHREC Articles, about Six, one of the deck\u2019s key cards): the guide explains the retrace / graveyard lands mechanic — \u201cSix allows you to cast stuff from your graveyard, at the puny cost of discarding a land\u201d — and warns that \u201cplaying less than 45 is going to hamper dramatically your chances to pull it off.\u201d It highlights the \u201cvery cheap outlets that can be recurred ad nauseam\u201d (Lotus Petal, baubles) and the land recursion that fills the graveyard before bringing everything back — exactly the engine of the Slogurk deck (Loam + fetchlands + Zuran Orb).
